title: heliomeris soliceps
intro: Heliomeris soliceps, commonly known as false heliotrope, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliomeris soliceps include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
